bug_semantics: Missing authorization on JSON user-registration APIs: POST /api/register and POST /api/v3.1/register (later /api/v4.0/register) call RegistrationHelper::createUser() without reading security.enableRegistration, so accounts can be created after an administrator has disabled visitor sign-up. The HTML registration page has enforced that flag since 2017; captcha/API-token checks on the JSON paths do not substitute for it. If spam.manualActivation is also off, the new account is activated immediately.
flaw_origin: 60d66e64766808dc1061627b3bebdafee5fd8269 (2020-10-28, feat(api): added REST API to register users, closes #1490) first replaced the api.php case 'register' 418 stub with token-gated createUser() and never consulted security.enableRegistration, which already existed (2015) and was enforced on the HTML registration page (2017). Parent 4e487a09873e2f5dd737a473f28afb64e412467f still has only the 418 stub. 94fc12e5852079a19dc98aab786cb7a5b1cc13ac (2024-02-27) moved the same unguarded REST path into Controller/Api/RegistrationController.php (refactor, not a first-write). 968bdc788de12db29e0bea41c30ba96a270036c3 (2024-03-10) added a second JSON surface (Frontend RegistrationController /api/register) with the same omitted check; that is a later same-mechanism write, not the BIC.
evidence: Vendor GHSA-h7q4-qgc4-c9vm (referenced by GHSA-fh25-jpw4-vg4p / CVE-2026-76209) and phpMyFAQ Security Advisory 2026-08-04 confirm a real registration-bypass: JSON register endpoints remain reachable when security.enableRegistration is false; patched in 4.1.7. GHSA-fh25 withdrawn_at is null; CVE.org/NVD list the CVE as published, not rejected. git show --stat 5013376cdc7986575f91f5804880ef9e80ca6498 adds the enableRegistration 403 gate to Controller/Api/RegistrationController.php and Controller/Frontend/RegistrationController.php; that commit is an ancestor of tag 4.1.7 and not of tag 4.1.6; git grep on 4.1.6 finds no enableRegistration in those controllers, 4.1.7 has the check. git log -S createUser -- phpmyfaq/api.php first hits 60d66e64766808dc1061627b3bebdafee5fd8269; parent tree cat-file -e 4e487a09873e2f5dd737a473f28afb64e412467f:phpmyfaq/api.php succeeds and the parent register arm is still $http->setStatus(418) with no createUser. git cat-file -p 60d66e64766808dc1061627b3bebdafee5fd8269 is a single-parent commit, author/committer Thorsten Rinne <thorsten@phpmyfaq.de>, message 'feat(api): added REST API to register users, closes #1490', no Co-Authored-By / Generated-with / bot author. Later 94fc12e5852079a19dc98aab786cb7a5b1cc13ac still has createUser on parent api.php (move). Frontend createUser first appears in 968bdc788de12db29e0bea41c30ba96a270036c3, also Thorsten Rinne with no AI markers.
reasoning: The advisory is a true missing-authorization bug, not withdrawn. The BIC is the smallest public commit that first wrote the unguarded JSON register sink, not the 2024 controller move and not the 2026 fix. That object is a 2020 human commit by Thorsten Rinne with no AI authorship markers on the commit; PR text and later AI-on-fix are out of scope. Therefore NOT_AI.
